Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Supreme Court junks petitions vs adjusted impeachment voting threshold

blocks.text: The Supreme Court dismisses the petitions questioning the Senate impeachment court’s ruling that adjusted the voting threshold for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment conviction.

items: Why was there a misunderstanding between Michael Poa and Paolo Panelo?

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense lawyer Michael Poa and Duterte’s newly appointed spokesperson Paolo Panelo disagree over a remark about impeachment proceedings.

items: The Gracioso affidavit: Ex-cop claims he delivered millions to Sara Duterte

blocks.text: Former police corporal Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. claims he delivered suitcases containing millions of pesos to Vice President Sara Duterte on different occasions.

items: Iran urges US voters to vote out Trump’s allies in election

blocks.text: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps urges Americans to vote out US President Donald Trump’s allies in Congress.

items: Chasing her ‘best version,’ Alex Eala reaches Asian Games semis for sure medal

blocks.text: Filipina tennis ace Alex Eala advances to the semifinal of the 2026 Asian Games after beating Chinese Taipei’s Joanna Garland, on Wednesday, September 30. – Rappler.com
